roster.g: Who works which shift, day by day
roster.w: A day-wise shift plan. A roster row puts an employee — or everyone in a company, branch, department, designation or team — on a Working Shift for a date range, overriding the shift Organization Setup assigns them. The month grid shows employee × day; the most recent row covering a day wins, so a one-day override is a one-day row saved after the range.
f: Assign a shift to one person or a whole scope
Month grid: employee × day → shift code
Cancel a row; the scoped shift applies again
s: Filter the grid to the company / branch / department / team you are rostering.
Pick who (one person, or everyone in the filter), the Working Shift, the dates, and press Roster.
For a single day, set From and To to the same date — it wins over the older range for that day.
Read the grid: bold is a roster row, faint is the scoped Working Shift.
roster.tip: Late marks and payable hours for a day are measured against the shift the roster gives that day. Roster night shifts before the month starts so the first night is not measured as a day shift.
roster.rel: Also see: Working Shifts, Late Policy, Daily Attendance
roster.why: A team on rotating shifts with no roster is a team whose late marks are wrong every second week. The roster is what makes attendance measure the day the person was actually asked to work.
roster.uc: Picture this: the collections floor moves to a 12–9 shift for the last week of the month. One row for the department, seven days, and every punch that week is judged against 12:00, not 09:30.
adv: Late marks measured against the real shift
Whole scopes rostered in one row
Nothing rewritten — every change is a dated row with a name on it

assets.w: The asset register — code, category, make/model, serial, purchase date and cost, condition and status — and the Issue & Return screen that moves an asset between in stock, assigned, under repair and retired, stamping who did it and when. Exit & FnF clearance reads the per-employee held list from here.
f: Issue and return with a who/when stamp
Assets held by one person, for clearance
s: Add the asset on the register: code, category, make/model, serial, cost.
On Issue & Return, pick the person and the date and press Issue.
When it comes back, press Return and record the condition.
Before an exit, open Issue & Return filtered to the person: it must be empty.
assets.tip: Edit facts (serial, cost) on the register; move status on Issue & Return. Moving status by editing the register row leaves no stamp of who issued it.
assets.why: Laptops and SIMs walk out of a company one resignation at a time. A register with a name and a date on every issue is the difference between a recovery and a write-off.
assets.uc: Picture this: an agent resigns. Clearance opens the held list — a phone and a SIM, issued in March. Both come back, the return is stamped, the settlement proceeds.
adv: Every asset has a holder or is in stock — never nowhere
Clearance checks a list, not memory
Cost in exact rupees for the write-off register
